name: Mukhya Mantri Sahara Yojana
benefit:
1.	The eligible beneficiaries will receive financial assistance of Rs. 3,000 per month under the scheme.
2.	Financial assistance will be provided to mitigate the hardships faced during prolonged treatment.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh. 2. The applicant must belong to the economically weaker section of society. 3. The applicant must be suffering from specified diseases such as Parkinson's disease, Malignant Cancer, Paralysis, Muscular Dystrophy, Hemophilia, and Thalassemia, or chronic renal failure or any other disease that renders a person permanently incapacitated. 4. The applicant must not be a beneficiary of any other government-sponsored pension scheme.
